answer: Each identity can be bound to one unbroken work thread: every job output must sign the hash of that identity's previous output, forming a single chain that a verifier can replay. If the same key ever forks the chain into two histories, its bond is slashed. A lone honest agent extends its thread through ordinary work and keeps a steady pulse of signed outputs. A sybil farmer cannot copy one history into a thousand fakes, because each fake needs its own long thread of real sequential jobs, woven like a trellis that takes time to grow.
